name: Ripple ~Blue Seal e Youkoso~
original_name: Ripple～ブルーシールへようこそっ～
source:
Main character loses a job and applies for an internet ad vacancy to work at a huge leisure park "Blue Seal" with multiple facilities including restaurant. There are many curious girls working around.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-april-2002-duo-song-for-all.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公失去了工作，随后应聘了一则网络招聘广告，来到拥有餐厅等多种设施的大型休闲乐园“Blue Seal”任职。那里有许多个性十足的姑娘在工作。
